label: Microsoft PowerPoint
description: Manage, copy, share and version PowerPoint files in OneDrive and SharePoint

operations.name: list_presentations
operations.description: List one page of folder children and return PowerPoint files (.pptx, .ppt, .ppsx, .pps, .potx, .pot, .pptm, .ppsm, .potm). The limit applies before filtering; next_link refers to the unfiltered Graph page.

operations.name: move_presentation
operations.description: Move a presentation to another folder in the same drive. Use the destination folder ID, including the root folder's actual ID.

operations.name: copy_presentation
operations.description: Start an asynchronous copy in the same drive. A 202 response means accepted; monitor_url tracks completion.

operations.name: delete_presentation
operations.description: Move the presentation to the recycle bin.

operations.name: preview_presentation
operations.description: Return a temporary preview for the caller's own use. Available for OneDrive for Business and SharePoint only.

operations.name: create_share_link
operations.description: Create or reuse a view/edit sharing link. Tenant sharing policy determines which scopes are allowed.

operations.name: update_permission
operations.description: Change a direct sharing permission's role. Inherited permissions cannot be changed here.

operations.name: delete_permission
operations.description: Remove a direct sharing permission; inherited permissions must be changed on the ancestor.

operations.name: restore_version
operations.description: Create a new current version from a previous version, preserving version history.
